about.a-small-family-business-open-six: A small family business, open six days a week, rated 9.0 out of 10 by 50 guests on Wolt.
about.by-late-afternoon-most-of-the: By late afternoon most of the baking is gone. That's how we'd like it: we would rather sell out than sell yesterday.
about.cinnamon-and-sugar-started-with-a: Cinnamon & Sugar started with a simple idea: the pastries people grow up with in Greece — bougatsa, kataifi, koulouri, karidopita — deserve a counter in Prenzlauer Berg, next to a coffee worth sitting down for. It is still a small family business, run day to day by the people who bake.
about.come-by-before-the-bougatsa-runs: Come by before the bougatsa runs out
about.delivery-on-wolt-and-uber-eats: Delivery on Wolt and Uber Eats inside roughly 3 km of the shop, or order ahead and pick it up on your way past.
about.early-mornings-short-menus-nothing: Early mornings, short menus, nothing left over
about.ekmek-kadayifi-kataifi-karidopita-: Ekmek kadayifi, kataifi, karidopita, trigonaki, cheesecake and a Lotus cheesecake — the Greek classics alongside a few Berlin ones.
about.feta-minced-meat-or-vanilla-cream: Feta, minced meat, or vanilla cream, wrapped in filo and baked in trays. The feta and the vanilla are the two our guests order most.
about.freddo-espresso-and-freddo-cappucc: Freddo espresso and freddo cappuccino, shaken cold with a proper foam, plus the instant-coffee frappé you can't get everywhere.
about.most-of-the-bagels-pitas-and: Most of the bagels, pitas and pastries are meat-free — mediterranean feta, mozzarella-pesto, spinach-feta pita, gourmet with olives.
about.salmon-and-egg-on-toasted-brioche: Salmon and egg on toasted brioche, bacon and avocado, Greek yoghurt with honey and granola, or a low-sugar banana bread.
about.the-ovens-go-on-before-the: The ovens go on before the street wakes up. Filo is layered for the bougatsa, the sesame rings go in, the croissants are proofed and baked so the first ones land on the counter as we unlock the door.
about.we-keep-the-menu-deliberately-smal: We keep the menu deliberately small — around fifty things, and most of them are made or finished the same day. Bagels and brioche sandwiches are built to order and toasted while you wait, which is why they take a few minutes longer than a pastry from the tray. It's worth it.
base.a-small-family-run-bakery-and: A small family-run bakery and coffee shop in Prenzlauer Berg. Greek bougatsa, fresh bagels, brioche sandwiches and proper freddo espresso — baked and brewed every morning on Lychener Straße.

index.cinnamon-and-sugar-is-a-small: Cinnamon & Sugar is a small family-run Greek bakery and coffee shop on Lychener Straße in Prenzlauer Berg. Brioche sandwiches toasted to order, bagels built while you wait, trays of bougatsa still warm from the oven — and coffee that takes breakfast seriously.
index.everything-on-the-counter-is-made: Everything on the counter is made for the morning — and most of it is gone by the afternoon.
index.five-bagels-and-two-toasted-brioch: Five bagels and two toasted brioche sandwiches — salmon and egg, bacon and avocado, mozzarella-pesto, mediterranean feta.
index.freddo-espresso-and-freddo-cappucc: Freddo espresso and freddo cappuccino shaken cold, the classic frappé, plus chai, matcha and hot chocolate with cream.
